facts.claim: DOOM OS is a heavily modified copy of stock 5.52, made by Klangfeld Labs (author Quintus Oostendorp). Current release 0.7.3, build 733D, dated 2026-11-04. It first appeared as 0.6-alpha (build 0C34, 2026-09-28) for stock 5.52.

facts.claim: Delivery: a browser-based patcher takes the user's own official stock 5.52 SP404MKII_APP1.bin and produces a patched APP1; nothing is uploaded. The patcher accepts only the official 5.52 file and checks the result against a published checksum list. The result is copied to the root of a FAT32 SD card and installed through the normal update menu (SHIFT held at power-on, then VALUE). Only APP1 is produced.

facts.claim: Base needed: official stock 5.52 only. DOOM OS keeps all stock functions; leaving DOOM OS returns to the stock interface. Going back to stock is done by running the updater with Roland's own file.

facts.claim: Open DOOM OS: hold REMAIN and press SUB PAD, from any screen. EXIT closes it and saves. Setting "Hold to Exit" (0.1 to 1.0 s) makes EXIT need a hold to close. Setting "Boot to DOOM" opens DOOM OS at start-up. Saving is automatic shortly after an edit.

evidence.label: DOC
evidence.source: DOOM OS manual (klangfeldlabs.com/doom-os/manual), Quickstart; All Controls, Basics; DOOM OS Settings

facts.claim: Screens DOOM OS adds: step grid (8 tracks, 16 steps = 16 pads, 5 views: GRID, LABELS, BEATS, BOTH, ZOOM with 4 tracks), piano roll, TRACK page and PATTERN panel (menus on RECORD SETTING), instrument browser (tabs INSTRUMENTS and KITS), instrument editor, parameter-lock editor, arpeggiator (ARP), pattern tools, mixer, EQ display and EQ screen, SIDECHAIN, FX Automation, bounce card, NEW NOTES settings, effect pages kept open, help mode, waveform overlay, and two tabs in SYSTEM (DOOM OS, SHORTCUT).

evidence.label: DOC
evidence.source: DOOM OS manual (klangfeldlabs.com/doom-os/manual), Getting Started to DOOM OS Settings

facts.claim: Pattern sequencer: pads are steps of the selected track; VALUE selects the track; CTRL1/2/3 set velocity, length, nudge for the whole track or, with a step pad held, for one note. SHIFT+CTRL1 on a held step sets pitch (12 semitones either way), SHIFT+CTRL2 sets fine length. REMAIN with a held pad keeps the note selected. New pattern: hold PATTERN SELECT and press an empty pad. Switching pattern during play waits for the end of the playing one; adding SUB PAD switches at once. PATTERN SELECT starts/stops play. Existing saved patterns can be edited only after they have played once since power-on.

evidence.label: DOC
evidence.source: DOOM OS manual (klangfeldlabs.com/doom-os/manual), Getting Started; Note Editing; All Controls, Basics, Tracks, Notes

facts.claim: Limits: up to 160 tracks shown, 16,384 notes per pattern (more still load and play but are not all shown), undo history about 11 to 12 steps (sources differ), patterns over 512 notes and effect movements are too big for undo. DOUBLE refuses past 64 bars or 512 notes.

evidence.label: DOC
evidence.source: DOOM OS CHANGELOG.md, 0.7, Improvements; DOOM OS manual (klangfeldlabs.com/doom-os/manual), TRACK Page and PATTERN Panel, Pattern Tools

facts.claim: Recording: REC once = rehearse (blinks), again = record, EXIT stops recording. Record modes SINGLE, MULTI, CHROMATIC, 16 VEL, changed with SHIFT+REC or in the PATTERN panel. SHIFT+PATTERN EDIT opens NEW NOTES (quantize, swing, live or fixed velocity, live or fixed length). SHIFT+pad 1 fixed velocity, SHIFT+pad 2 turns 16 VEL on, SHIFT+pad 9 cycles metronome ON, RECPLAY, OFF. HOLD does nothing while REC is on.

evidence.label: DOC
evidence.source: DOOM OS manual (klangfeldlabs.com/doom-os/manual), Recording; All Controls, Recording

facts.claim: Bounce in place: RESAMPLE records the selected track with its effects onto a chosen empty pad and replaces the track's notes with one note on the new pad; SHIFT+RESAMPLE records everything heard and leaves the pattern as it is. Modes CUT, TAIL (up to 30 s tail), LOOP. Undo with SHIFT+PATTERN SELECT. A pad that has a sample or notes is refused.

evidence.label: DOC
evidence.source: DOOM OS manual (klangfeldlabs.com/doom-os/manual), Bounce in Place

facts.claim: Instruments: 20 built-in sound engines and 11 drum kits. Instruments: BASS, POLY, FM, WAVE, MALLET, PERC, Kick, Snare, Clap, Hats, Rim, Bell, Rasp, Kick8, Kick9, Snare8, Snare9, Claps, Tom8, Tom9. Kits: 909, 808, 707, 727, 606, CR-78, BOOM, LOFI, TRAP, DUST, DOOM. An instrument is loaded onto a pad by holding SUB PAD and tapping an empty pad; the sound is also saved to the pad as an ordinary sample, so the pad plays in stock screens. Instrument editor: START/END on an instrument track; VALUE selects section, CTRL1-3 set parameters, SHIFT = finer, SHIFT+pad 4 chromatic play, BANK buttons pick octave, REMAIN swaps the instrument.

facts.claim: Parameter locks per step on instrument tracks: MARK on the grid or in the instrument editor enters lock mode, tap a step, set CTRL knobs, MARK saves, EXIT discards, DEL resets the step. Locked steps show blue pads. Locks play only when the pattern plays the note, not when a pad is struck by hand. Limits: 4096 locks per project, 64 steps per session, 126 per track in a pattern.

facts.claim: Arpeggiator: RECORD SETTING menu, ARP. Pads become a keyboard in a chosen key and scale; HOLD latches. PLAY page: TYPE (11 types), RATE (1/4 to 1/32 with triplets), GATE. PITCH page: KEY, SCALE (40), OCT (up to 3). VALUE toggles arp on/off and switches pages. PRINT ARP writes the arpeggio into the track as notes (replaces all notes on that track, undoable).

Pan, bus and level are the pad's own stock settings, so they sound in every stock screen too. SHIFT+VALUE mute, SHIFT+ROLL solo, tapping a pad mutes it, REMAIN+pad solos a track. facts.claim: Delivery: browser patcher on the site. Install via SD card, SHIFT at power-on, VALUE. The patcher refuses to build a file that alters Roland's start-up and update code, so the way back to stock stays the same. APP0 is never to be put on the card.

SHIFT plus a pad switches a bus's whole stack on or off, latched or while held. Which pad maps to which bus, and how this coexists with stock SHIFT+pad shortcuts, is not stated.

It is built on, and includes, DOOM OS 0.6.1 (build ED5E). It extends the stock Sound Generator introduced in 5.52 with a four-voice synth, added waveforms, envelope presets, scales, arpeggiator, MIDI-in, and 13 synthesized drum machine kits.

facts.claim: Sound Generator additions: four live voices, 17 added waves (FM1:1, FM1:2, FM1:7, CZSaw, CZSqr, CZRes, Sync, Fold, Drive, LPSaw, LPSqr, Organ, Vowel, Table, Logic, Metal, Grit), nine ENV presets (Pluck, Perc, Keys, Pad, Swell, Bass, Acid, Sweep, FPad; four with filter envelope), 34 scales (pads then play only scale notes), an arpeggiator (UP, DOWN, UP&DN, RAND, ORDER, CHORD; seven rates; octave range plus or minus 3; HOLD), MIDI IN to all four voices, held-chord REC. Normal sample pads and patterns do not become live synth pads.

facts.claim: Thirteen synthesized kits modelled on classic drum machines (TR808, DR110, KPR77, UDS, FM, TR909, TR606, SDS-V, Mini Pops 7, CR78, CR8K, TR707, TR727). SHIFT+PATTERN EDIT opens Kits (from the main screen, the RESAMPLE screen with a take armed, and the LOOPER screen); SHIFT+RECORD SETTING returns to the melodic Sound Generator. In kits: CTRL1/2/3 = tune, decay, tone; tapping SHIFT swaps to a second parameter page; holding a pad and turning VALUE steps through that machine's sounds; VALUE menu items include ARP, RATE, HOLD, BPM, KIT, PAD, SOUND, LEVEL, M.CH, BOUNC. BOUNC writes the current kit into the 16 pads of a sample bank. REC in drum mode records the last drums struck together.

facts.claim: Tallfree is a screen reader for the SP-404MKII, by Mudb0y (copyright holder in its LICENSE: Stanislaw Przedzinkowski). It is modified stock 5.52 that speaks screen titles, selected items, values, tab names, dialogs, bank letters, effect names and the on/off state of GATE, LOOP, REVERSE, BPM SYNC and EXT SOURCE. Voice: OpenEVV, an Eloquence-like engine running on the SP. Speech plays through the main outputs and is not recorded when sampling or resampling.

evidence.label: DOC
evidence.source: Tallfree README (github.com/Mudb0y/tallfree), intro, What it reads

facts.claim: Delivery: a release zip laid out as the SD card: Tallfree's APP1, Roland's unchanged APP0 from 5.52, and the speech engine TALLFREE.BIN in a TALLFREE folder. Installed with the normal update (SHIFT at power-on, VALUE). The engine copies itself to internal memory a few seconds after start-up. After the update APP0 and APP1 should be deleted from the card. An empty file NOENGINE in the TALLFREE folder starts the unit without the engine.

evidence.source: Tallfree README (github.com/Mudb0y/tallfree), Installing, If something goes wrong

facts.claim: Base: stock 5.52, 13 bytes changed plus a small boot loader. Cost: the looper and skip-back buffer is halved, from 27.3 s to 13.65 s per channel, to make room for the speech engine. Nothing else is said to change.

facts.claim: Speech settings open with SHIFT+EXIT on any screen: VALUE chooses Speed, Pitch, Voice, Volume, Abbreviations or Screen reading; EXIT saves and closes. In stock, SHIFT+EXIT is listed as a stop-everything shortcut on the main screen; whether Tallfree replaces or keeps that is not stated.

facts.claim: Compatibility with DOOM OS, Side-Piece, Tampal or Etc is not documented. The cut looper buffer and the engine in its own memory region are reasons to test any combination.

facts.claim: Which mods build on which base: DOOM OS from stock 5.52; Etc from stock 5.52 and includes DOOM OS 0.6.1; Tampal from stock 5.52 or from a DOOM OS image (0.6.1 to 0.7.3); Side-Piece from stock 5.52; Tallfree from stock 5.52. Only Tampal is documented to stack on another mod. The Screen Loader tool uses Roland's own feature and changes no firmware. No other SP-404MKII firmware mod, and nothing called "Sampled", was found in public search.

facts.claim: Keys taken by mods outside their own screens: DOOM OS REMAIN+SUB PAD (open); Side-Piece SHIFT+PATTERN EDIT (FX screen) and SHIFT+CTRL1/2/3 on the main screen; Etc SHIFT+PATTERN EDIT (kits) with SHIFT+RECORD SETTING; Tallfree SHIFT+EXIT. SHIFT+PATTERN EDIT is used by both Side-Piece and Etc, and inside DOOM OS it means NEW NOTES, so these mods cannot share it.
